description: Tile residency budget and hysteresis for the map streamer.

residency.comment: Evicting further out than loading is deliberate. A single radius makes tiles thrash in and out every time the player walks back and forth across a tile boundary.

budget.comment: Spawning is amortised across frames. Committing a whole 512 m tile in one frame is a visible hitch. 420 covers the whole 17 x 24 grid, which a vantage point can want: tiles out there bring only their long-range LODs.

prefetch.comment: Also want the tiles around where the player will be in velocity_lead_seconds -- the car's velocity when seated -- so tiles ahead are read before they are reached. Capped inside the evict radius.

vantage.comment: Up high, stream further: a tile more for every metres_per_tile the player stands above base_metres, up to max_extra_tiles (10 more is about 7 km). Far tiles spawn at SLOD bands, so this costs reading, not drawing every railing. The evict radius grows by the same, and shrinks half a step late on the way down.
